description: What the cook has on Befana: saved recipes, recipes they published, their variations, shopping lists and meal plans (from the web or any assistant), their ratings, and a count of their pantry. Use it to answer "what did I save?" or to reopen a list. Same as My Kitchen on the website. When newly_assigned is present, tell the cook first, once: those recipes were added to their kitchen by Befana (they're the owner and can edit them). When fixes_asked is present, tell the cook (once, it isn't repeated): Befana's reviewers asked for these specific fixes on their recipes before launch; offer to make them with update_recipe after showing the changes. Keeping them is the default; if the cook says one isn't theirs, hand_back_recipe returns it.
